name: Tables
author: Smart Terminal
summary: Read CSV and TSV as a table instead of as commas.
description: Brings its own code: the app has no idea how to read a delimited file, and this extension is what teaches it. Quoted fields, embedded commas and newlines, and doubled quotes are all handled; the first row is treated as a header when it looks like one. Runs in a worker with no access to the app, the disk or the page.
